units: usd_m = USD millions, pct = percent, usd = dollars per share. All figures non-GAAP, as Micron guides.
fiscal_note: Fiscal year ends around the start of September (FQ1 = Sep-Nov). FY26 had 53 weeks; FQ4 FY26 was a 14-week quarter, known when it was guided. Guidance on call N is graded against results reported on call N+1.

sources.transcripts: FMP earningsTranscript (search-transcripts, MU). The 2024-12-18, 2026-06-24 and 2026-09-30 FMP records are the post-earnings analyst Q&A only.
sources.guidance_and_actuals: Micron earnings press releases (GlobeNewswire) incl. the 2025-08-11 guidance update; Micron prepared remarks PDFs (investors.micron.com) for FQ1 FY25, FQ3 FY26, FQ4 FY26.
sources.cross_check: FMP earnings-company (non-GAAP EPS, revenue) and income-statement / cashflow-statement.
